explain: A structural Protocol states only the capability the consumer needs. A matching adapter does not have to inherit a framework base class.
steps: Describe a search capability with a typed method. || Pass a plain adapter implementing that method to the consumer.
name: small-interface

explain: A registry chooses an adapter factory; a builder validates configuration before constructing it. A strategy is the behavior selected through that boundary.
steps: Register two construction functions under explicit names. || Reject an unknown backend and construct the selected adapter.
name: builder-registry

explain: An added abstraction should satisfy a named requirement. The small decision function keeps a simple local implementation when no demonstrated requirement justifies a separate runtime.
steps: Express the missing capability as a boolean requirement. || Choose the smaller implementation until durable branching is actually needed.
name: architecture-boundary

explain: A dataclass preserves explicit outcomes and an API converter selects public fields. Internal diagnostics do not leak into the response.
steps: Construct a typed service result. || Convert only status and task identity at the API boundary.
name: typed-result

explain: Capability flags distinguish portable operations from backend-specific ones. A generic adapter cannot promise a PostgreSQL advisory lock on every backend.
steps: Declare the backend's implemented capabilities. || Gate an unsupported operation instead of emulating a stronger guarantee accidentally.
name: sql-portability

explain: A no-op telemetry implementation lets optional diagnostics be injected without conditional checks throughout business logic. Mandatory audit requirements need a separate policy.
steps: Provide a telemetry object with the expected method. || Run domain logic without external telemetry or network access.
name: null-telemetry

explain: An architecture decision is a versioned artifact with evidence and a reconsideration trigger. Its fields make an interview or review claim inspectable.
steps: Record the decision, observed evidence, and a measurable revisit condition. || Check that the required fields exist before publishing the record.
name: adr
